lessons.title: Practice Retrieve by Overlap
lessons.description: Implement retrieve(query, chunks, k) scoring by shared lowercase tokens; return top-k chunk strings. The test checks that retrieve('cats', chunks, 2)[0] equals 'cats are nice'.
learning_objectives: Orchard potters recount crates before dawn, and retrieve chunks by token overlap.
lessons.solution_code:
def retrieve(query, chunks, k):
    q = set(query.lower().split())
    scored = []
    for i, ch in enumerate(chunks):
        score = len(q & set(ch.lower().split()))
        scored.append((score, i, ch))
    scored.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1]))
    positives = [ch for score, _, ch in scored[:k] if score > 0]
    return positives if positives else [ch for _, _, ch in scored[:k]]

tests.name: test_retrieve

lessons.title: Practice Pack Context
lessons.description: Implement pack_context(chunks, budget) joining with a separator without exceeding budget chars. The test checks that pack_context(['ab', 'cd'], 100) equals 'ab' + sep + 'cd'; pack_context(['abcdef'], 3) equals ''.
learning_objectives: Quarry potters recount crates before dawn, and pack retrieved context under a budget.

tests.name: test_pack_context
tests.unittest_code:
def test_pack_context(self):
    sep = chr(10) + '---' + chr(10)
    self.assertEqual(pack_context(['ab', 'cd'], 100), 'ab' + sep + 'cd')
    self.assertEqual(pack_context(['abcdef'], 3), '')

source.name: LlamaIndex — assembling retrieved nodes as context for a query

lessons.title: Practice Checkpoint Citation Map
lessons.description: Implement cite(chunks) returning list of id/text dicts. The test checks that cite(['a', 'b']) equals [{'id': 0, 'text': 'a'}, {'id': 1, 'text': 'b'}].
learning_objectives: Attic potters recount crates before dawn, and attach citation ids to chunks.
lessons.solution_code:
def cite(chunks):
    return [{'id': i, 'text': c} for i, c in enumerate(chunks)]
